title: Reading Drill — Adjusting a departure board — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Adjusting a departure board — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The travel information team in Bramley received an old report about short messages clearing before visitors finish reading. The report compared the proportion of messages understood, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the reading tests rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered ten weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include competing messages nearby. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a slower change interval as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
